verdict.rationale: MX documents a Platform API, with a published OpenAPI spec on GitHub, for connecting end users through the Connect Widget, retrieving balances, and pulling account and transaction history. A probe also found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, and credentials are handled as API keys with rotation. Missing for 10: evidence that credentials can be scoped or permission-limited, detail on what the MCP server actually exposes, explicit API operations for managing or deleting connections, and independent hands-on corroboration.
